title: GrOCE: Graph-Guided Online Concept Erasure for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a concept erasure framework (GrOCE) for text-to-image diffusion models to remove specific targets like cartoon characters and art styles. While it cites safety and ethics as a general motivation for why concept erasure is necessary, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, ethics, or moral reasoning.
